h1: eBay inventory sync, one set of stock numbers
overview: If you sell on eBay and in your own store, stock numbers drift and you oversell. We connect eBay with your store using a sync tool that fits your platform, map your products by SKU, and test that a sale on either side reduces stock on both. We set the rules for low stock and out of stock, and write a short guide to what to check when something looks off. The tool subscription is paid by you.

faq: Shopify, WooCommerce, BigCommerce and Wix stores are the common ones, through well known sync apps or eBay's own tools. Tell us your platform and we confirm a fit before we start.
Do I pay for the sync tool?
Yes. Most sync tools bill monthly, and you pay the tool maker directly. We pick an option that fits your size, tell you the cost first and set it up in your own accounts.
Will it fix my existing mismatched stock?
We correct counts using the numbers you trust, then turn on the sync. If SKUs are missing or duplicated, we clean them first, since sync depends on one unique SKU per item.
What if a sale happens in both places at once?
Sync tools can lag by a few minutes, so a rare double sale is still possible. We set a safety buffer on fast sellers to make that less likely.
